Osmotic diuretics such as mannitol are first-line drugs for the management of raised intrac- ranial pressure (p.1181) but loop diuretics such as furosemide may be used as adjuncts. Tinnitus. Furosemide is one of many drugs that have been tried in tinnitus (p.1866), but although reported to be effective in some patients, it is rarely used because of problems with adverse ef- fects.
